question: The approximate length of the Great Himalayan range, also known as the central axial range, is ______ km from east to west.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2500**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The approximate length of the Great Himalayan range, also known as the central axial range.
 
• It is 2,500 km from east to west, and their width varies between 160-400 km from north to south. 
 
• The Himalayas consist of three parallel ranges - Himadri, Himachal & Shiwaliks.
 
• Himadri is also known as Inner Himalayas or Greater Himalayas.
 
• Himachal is also known as Middle Himalayas or Lesser Himalayas.
 
• Shiwalik is also known as Outer Himalayas.
